source:
@@U00128@@
concocting a ragout from other men’s feasts, blowing paltry flames from your pile of ashes. It will win you the applause of children and fools, if that’s to your taste. But you'll never move men’s hearts or unite them unless it comes straight from your own heart.

@@U00130@@
Yes, but it’s the delivery that counts; and believe me, I know how much I’ve still to learn.

@@U00132@@
Make an honest living. Don’ go around a fool with bells tinkling. Good sense and an honest message speak for themselves without much art. If you're really serious, and have something to say, what need is there to hunt for words? You and those dazzling speeches of yours, crammed with bits and pieces from everywhere, are about as refreshing as the foggy autumn wind rustling dry leaves.

@@U00134@@
O God! Art is so long and life so short! There are times in my studies when my heart sinks with any confidence I once had. So much to master to work your way up to the sources! And before we're even halfway there were dead, poor devils.

@@U00136@@
Your manuscript! Is that the holy fountain that will quench your thirst forever? You'll never know refreshment till it hows from deep within you.
translation:
@@U00128@@
用别人的盛宴调制炖菜，从你的骨灰堆中吹出微不足道的火焰。如果你喜欢的话，它会为你赢得孩子们和傻瓜们的掌声。但除非直接出自你自己的内心，否则你永远无法打动人们的心或团结他们。

@@U00130@@
是的，但重要的是交付；相信我，我知道我还有很多东西需要学习。

@@U00132@@
诚实地生活。不要绕着一个铃铛叮当作响的傻瓜走。良好的判断力和诚实的信息本身就说明了一切，无需太多艺术。如果你真的很认真，有话要说，何必去寻找言语呢？你和你那些令人眼花缭乱的演讲，塞满了来自各地的点点滴滴，就像雾蒙蒙的秋风吹干树叶一样令人耳目一新。

@@U00134@@
上帝啊！艺术如此漫长，生命如此短暂！在我的学习中，有时我的心因我曾经拥有的信心而沉沦。要想深入了解源代码，需要掌握很多东西！我们还没走到一半，可怜的家伙们就已经死了。

@@U00136@@
你的手稿！那是永远解渴的圣泉吗？除非它从你内心深处产生，否则你永远不会知道什么是清爽。
